question: Which section of the Merutantra concludes with this exposition on the lamp rite?
premises: The text is the Merutantra composed by Śrī Śiva
The section concerns the lamp rite
It is identified as the twenty-fifth exposition
inference: This concludes the twenty-fifth exposition, on the lamp rite, in the Merutantra.
plain_english: Thus, in the Merutantra composed by Śrī Śiva and approved by Śrī Mahāmāyā and Mahākāla, this is the twenty-fifth exposition on the lamp rite.
